description: Labelled questions for evaluating retrieval and answer quality on the sample arXiv papers. Each keyword list is treated as synonyms: a case passes if any keyword is present. Fetch the PDFs first with scripts/fetch_samples.py.

cases.question: What model architecture does this paper introduce?
What mechanism does the model rely on instead of recurrence?
What task is used to evaluate the model?
What kind of representations does BERT learn?
What pre-training objective does BERT use to predict hidden tokens?
What benchmark dataset is used for image classification?
What idea do the authors use to ease training of very deep networks?
What medical condition does the model detect?
What type of medical images does the model analyse?
